verdict.summary: The new drift gate consistently binds the inference report heading and headline total to the emitter, the active CI extraction commands, both binary-runner RATCHET literals, the generated scoreboard registry, and the Rust scoreboard documentation. Its checks fail closed on missing inputs or malformed registry JSON, avoid counting commented-out shell commands, and the hermetic mutation table exercises each claimed binding rather than merely asserting success. Both the 16-case self-test and the gate against the PR checkout pass. The report edit restores the exact emitted heading and keeps the totals inside CI's -A2 parse window. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test defect was found in the diff.
